description: Source code for the CPowerState class managing power states via IARM bus calls, including setting and getting power states.

classes.name: CPowerState
classes.description: Singleton class managing power state transitions via IARM bus.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CPowerState.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the power state management, currently a stub returning true.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the power state management, currently a stub returning true.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets the power state based on input string ('STANDBY', 'ON', 'DEEP_SLEEP', 'LIGHT_SLEEP').

methods.name: getPowerState
methods.description: Retrieves the current power state as a string ('ON', 'STANDBY', or 'UNKNOWN').
